data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 Jan 2016 was $165.426m (restated 2015 closing). Prior-year development, calculated from the gross claims development table, shows a net adverse movement of $13.5m (strengthening), largely driven by development on earlier underwriting years (notably 2014) including notable losses such as the SpaceX satellite loss and an Energy account loss. Note 6 comments a small net release in prior year reserves on a net-of-reinsurance basis ($3.362m), however no explicit gross prior-year movement is provided in the movement note, so the gross triangle has been used as the primary source.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net claims incurred of $142,768,000 (2015: $104,327,000) is a release of $3,362,000 from claims reserves established at the prior year (2015: release $1,923,000).
Loss activity reflects Hurricane Matthew, an increase in US designated catastrophes, notably in respect of flood and hail losses, and the SpaceX satellite.
There were two other notable risk losses on the Energy account and the SpaceX satellite loss on the Specie & Cargo account.

data.data_quality_notes: All monetary figures are reported in the syndicate's presentation currency (USD). The Balance Sheet (liabilities) shows gross claims outstanding at 31/12/2015 = $165,426k used as opening reserves. No explicit GROSS 'movement in prior year's provision' figure is presented in note 6; note 6 instead states a NET release of $3,362k. Therefore the gross prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (page 56) which yields a net adverse movement (strengthening) of $13.5m (USD). This differs from the net release quoted in note 6; the difference is due to reinsurance recoveries and classification of current-year vs prior-year movements. Prior-year development confidence rated 0.8 because it is calculated from the published gross triangle (explicit) rather than directly stated as a gross movement in the notes.
